description:
The proposal has been assessed against all relevant permitted development limitations and conditions for roof enlargements, as set out below:

Volume Allowance: The proposed roof enlargement does not exceed 40 cubic metres (applicable to terraced dwellings).
Height: The development does not exceed the height of the existing roof.
Position on Roof: No part of the development extends beyond the plane of the existing roof slope forming the principal elevation fronting the highway.
Setback from Eaves: The dormer is set back at least 200mm from the eaves of the existing roof slope.
Materials: External materials will be similar in appearance to the existing dwellinghouse.
Verandas/Balconies: No verandas, balconies or raised platforms are proposed.
Side-Facing Windows: No side-facing windows are proposed; therefore, no overlooking concerns arise.
Rooflights: The proposed rooflights to the front elevation will not project more than 150mm beyond the plane of the roof slope.
Designated Land: The property is not located within a designated area where Class B rights are restricted or removed.

The proposal complies with all relevant limitations and conditions of permitted development legislation and is therefore lawful.
